corrected_claim: The 30 Sep / 1 Oct 2023 boundary was the US federal government FUNDING (FY2024 appropriations) deadline - a shutdown was averted by a stopgap continuing resolution. The separate debt-ceiling limit had been suspended by the Fiscal Responsibility Act of June 2023 until 1 Jan 2025, not 30 Sep 2023. The speaker conflated the two.
notes: Debt-ceiling vs appropriations conflation; speaker's premise about the Sept 30 expiry is wrong
